scope: Commander renderer authoritative list/search snapshot consistency, strict read-only recovery, selection/history lifetime, refcounted event retirement and exact turn terminal handling. Existing typed native operations only.

fixture.profiles: Synthetic actual typed NativeDesktopHost/client/codecs/transport and Zustand, with controlled native invoke/events, no preload. All20 Commander controls use the native boundary; no provider/OS WebView/Source SQLite accessed by these renderer tests. E2 window source28343c43 and evidence8c9c2038 are independent native proofs.

expectedActual.expected: Search/filter changes, accepted create/rename/archive and session events cannot be overwritten by a held list.
expectedActual.actual: Coalesced snapshot reader invalidates on those inputs and retries at most8 reads. Query membership comes from Source title/body search, with an independent all-sessions inbox read during search. Accepted mutations are invoked exactly once; current sessions/unread metadata survive delayed reads.

expectedActual.expected: Retired selection/document/connection history cannot mark reports read or overwrite current history.
expectedActual.actual: Captured selection plus document and native connection generations fence list/history publication and follow-up report reads. Same-thread reselection, same-epoch reconnect, last subscriber release and pagehide controls pass. Drafts persist; recovery does not setActive/markRead/send.

expectedActual.expected: Recovery merges live messages/turns without restarting a completed or overwriting a newer turn.
expectedActual.actual: Finished-turn cache prevents delayed history revival. Newer live turns survive history; an older done terminal only clears its matching turn. Current done still clears current streaming state.

expectedActual.expected: One event cohort survives multiple views and retires exactly once.
expectedActual.actual: Reference-counted native event subscription shares one callback, removes it on final release/pagehide/HMR, fences direct queued callback invocation, and an old unsubscriber cannot retire a replacement cohort.

expectedActual.expected: Failed/busy recovery remains fenced and retry is explicit.
expectedActual.actual: Strict list recovery failure holds actual native mutation fence; successful explicit reconnect restores it. Eight deliberate rename invalidations produce BACKPRESSURE with exactly8 writes and no automatic replay.
